Name: Sir Robert's Orange and Gold Flowers
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This is a small collection of orange and gold flowers to brighten your home in Stardew Valley. I loved the colors so much from my previous mod that I simply had to use them again! I also "recycled" some of my flowers because I wanted to have different variations in size, height and color. They are a cheerful medley of petunias, daisies and hibiscuses. [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]There are 14 images alternating in orange and gold petals with a variety of colorful vases to choose from via Alternative Textures. (Plus, I included a set of images that can be placed on countertops). You can mix & match with my previous marigold mod or any of my other flower mods for full maximum impact. I love each and every flower that I've created and I hope they bring you lots of cheer and happiness as you use them in the game. Next on my wishlist is to create a perfect daffodil...until then, happy decorating to all![/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Installation instructions[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. When you play the game, the images will be found in the Decor/Houseplants section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Main features[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Images #1 through #14 can be placed on end tables.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #15 has been moved up a few pixels and can be placed on countertops.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Requirements[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Shout outs[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]The end tables in the pictures are made by Platinum Cats and lululovely. I also used end tables from the Stardew Valley furniture catalog. The countertops are made by Platinum Cats and lululovely. The last picture is the interior of a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36501]buildable flower shop[/url] by Himetarts & Wildflour; the flowers in the pots are from my mods and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35943]flower arrangements on the walls[/url] are by Himetarts & Wildflour. [/size][/color]
